headline: Guard Note for default_types.rs Modifications
why: This file defines the DEFAULT_TYPES constant, which is crucial for file type recognition in the ignore crate. Changes to this list could affect how various file types are processed across multiple dependent files.
checklist: Review all changes to the DEFAULT_TYPES constant for correctness.
Ensure that any new file types added are popular open formats.
Maintain the lexicographical order and 79-column wrapping in the list.
Check for consistency with existing file type patterns and formats.
